LanguageData.AMJ_Culture_EntranceAddDesc: Mark a shoe-changing threshold that shares an edge with a no-shoes area. May overlap floors and other zones. Disconnected entrances do not trigger shoe changes.
LanguageData.AMJ_Culture_EntranceRemoveDesc: Erase painted entrance threshold cells without removing any floor or other zone.
LanguageData.AMJ_Culture_EntranceNotAdjacent: This entrance is not adjacent to a no-shoes area. No shoe change will occur.
LanguageData.AMJ_Culture_NoShoesAddDesc: Mark rooms and floors where shoes are removed, such as raised wooden interiors. Paint beside an entrance threshold. Other zones and flooring are not affected.
LanguageData.AMJ_Culture_NoShoesRemoveDesc: Clear no-shoes area cells without changing flooring or other zones.
